versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Start on APIDot" section listing direct entry points for ClawHub users.
- Improved onboarding clarity by highlighting model page, docs, dashboard, and example links at the top.
- No functional or behavioral changes; documentation update only.

Initial release of the APIDot Kling 3.0 Turbo API skill.

- Provides documentation-only integration support for APIDot Kling 3.0 Turbo video workflows.
- Covers fast video previews, text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-shot video tasks, async jobs, polling, and webhook patterns.
- Strictly avoids executable scripts, network calls, and storage of credentials; all content is non-executable.
- Includes links and guidance for using APIDot docs, model pages, and workflow planning.
- Outlines best practices for secure API key handling and sensitive data.
- Helps users route Kling 3.0 Turbo questions to the right APIDot documentation.
